svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drawn upside down: the top view shows the floor (the face with the ports).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Floor: two 22 mm sensor ports, 22 mm each side of the centre, on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre line front to back. The 25 mm discs rest on the 1.5 mm ledge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Floor: four 3.4 mm holes for the standoff screws, 40 mm each side of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre and 25 mm each side of the front-to-back centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top: one 16.2 mm hole at the centre for the M16 cable gland.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back: two 4.4 mm wall screw holes, 35 mm each side of centre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 15 mm below the top. The lid face points into the room.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tape the faces, pilot drill 3 mm, open the ports with a step drill.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr; clean with water only (solvent residue poisons the sensor).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a disc laid on each port covers it with an even ledge all round.
